costNote: Artificial Analysis measured Composer 2.5 standard at $0.07 and 9.3 minutes per task, while CursorBench 3.2 reports Composer 2.5 at $0.44 per task. This report does not copy either dollar figure directly onto DeepSWE. Instead, it uses Composer-to-peer cost ratios within each benchmark and maps those ratios onto overlapping DeepSWE peers: optimistic uses the AA implied median (~$0.10), base averages the AA and CursorBench implied medians (~$0.44), and pessimistic uses the CursorBench near-peer upper bound (~$1.02). Composer minutes remain estimated from DeepSWE-vs-SWE-bench Pro runtime ratios and are not observed DeepSWE v1.1 runs.

optimistic.costMethod: AA near-peer median mapped onto DeepSWE peers

base.costMethod: average of AA-implied and CursorBench-implied DeepSWE medians

pessimistic.costMethod: CursorBench near-peer upper bound mapped onto DeepSWE peers

methodology.summary: Generated from benchmark source files and DeepSWE artifacts. Do not edit by hand; run scripts/recalculate_composer_estimate.py instead.

runtimeRatios.note: Retained from the last DeepSWE/SWE-bench Pro overlap; DeepSWE v1.1 has no comparison rows.
